purpose: Exploratory development run of a lightweight static task-quality audit; not held-out method evaluation
limits: The run predates the frozen experimental skill and helped design it; it is development data.
The labels BROKEN, QUESTIONABLE, and VALID are legacy local rubric labels, not catalog statuses.
All reviews are agent-assisted static judgments, not independent human validation.
No repository, task tests, grader, setup script, reference patch, or candidate patch was executed.
Annotator severity differed substantially across primary batches.
Unflagged tasks remain unlabeled; sample outcomes are not corpus prevalence.
The unstable-ID screen identifies textual candidates. It does not establish that the published parser compares those strings without normalization.
